rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something calmly and without agitation.

example.english: I placidly explained the matter to him.
example.traditional: 我平靜咁同佢講清楚件事。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ping4 zing6 gam3 tung4 keoi5 gong2 cing1 co2 gin6 si6

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on doing something quietly and without drawing attention.

example.english: I left placidly without drawing attention to myself.
example.traditional: 我靜靜咁離開，冇驚動到人。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zing6 zing2 gam3 lei4 hoi1 mou5 ging1 dung6 dou3 jan4
